core\utils\gpu\scene3d.ts
Sourcesrc/core\utils\gpu\scene3d.ts
UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

SCENE3D_NONE

u32::MAX — the wasm registry's sentinel for "none": attach a node to the scene root (parent), or bind no texture to a material (tex). One constant serves both slots since the Rust registry types share the id space.

(module scope)

The wasm-pack Surface3d handle — one method per pub fn in rust/scene3d/src/wasm.rs, flat scalars + typed-array views only (no serde structs, ~64B/call boundary cost). Geometry/material/ texture/node ids are u32 registry indices; stale ids no-op inside the engine. Declared here rather than imported from the artifact .d.ts so core/ stays standalone.

resize

Backing-store resize in DEVICE px — depth + surface re-configure.

set_size

CSS size — retained for contract parity (no-op on the engine).

gen_sphere

UV-sphere generator → geometry id (asPoints = point expansion).

gen_plane

Plane generator → geometry id.

gen_ring

Flat ring generator → geometry id.

gen_box

Box generator → geometry id.

gen_cylinder

Cylinder/cone generator → geometry id.

gen_torus

Torus generator → geometry id.

gen_icosahedron

Icosahedron generator → geometry id (detail subdivides).

gen_tetrahedron

Tetrahedron generator → geometry id.

upload_geometry

Custom geometry upload — SoA typed arrays (positions 3n, normals 3n, uvs 2n, indices 3k) → geometry id.

upload_texture

Decoded bitmap → texture id (GPU→GPU upload, zero readback).

add_material_basic

Unlit texel·color material → material id.

add_material_standard

Blinn-Phong lit material → material id.

add_material_sprite

Billboard sprite material → material id.

add_material_points

Expanded-quad point-sprite material → material id.

set_material_flags

Pipeline flags on a registered material — side 0=front/1=back/ 2=double, blending 0=normal/1=additive, plus transparent + depth-write toggles.

set_emissive

Additive self-lit tint on a material.

set_color

Base rgba on a material — alpha is the opacity slot for per-frame fade/highlight arms (one uniform-pack row per write).

add_mesh

Triangle mesh node under parent (SCENE3D_NONE = root) → node id.

add_points

Points node → node id.

add_sprite

Billboard sprite node → node id.

add_instanced

Instanced-mesh node with a fixed instance capacity → node id.

add_group

Transform-only group node → node id.

add_lod

LOD switch node → node id (children carry set_lod_ranges).

set_lod_range

Distance range at which an LOD child is drawn.

remove

Detaches + drops a node subtree.

set_position

Local-space position write.

set_euler

Local-space euler rotation write (radians).

set_scale

Local-space scale write.

node_look_at

Orients the node's -Z (or billboard normal) at a world target.

set_visible

Subtree visibility toggle.

set_layers

Layer bitmask write (camera masks cull against it).

set_render_order

Painter-order tiebreak inside a pass.

set_user_data

Opaque f64 user slot (body ids, catalog indices).

user_data

Reads the user slot back.

set_instance

Writes one 16-f32 instance matrix on an instanced node.

world_position

World-space position of a node → [x, y, z].

set_camera

Camera eye position.

camera_look_at

Camera look-at target.

set_orbit

Orbit rig — target + distance + yaw/pitch; once set, the camera derives its eye each frame from the orbit state (the JS input controller writes these six scalars per gesture).

set_fov

Vertical field of view, degrees.

set_clip

Near/far clip planes.

set_camera_layers

Camera layer mask — culls nodes whose mask doesn't intersect.

set_light

The single scene point light — position + rgb + intensity.

set_clear

Clear color rgba 0-1 (transparent black composites over the page).

set_post

Post-chain amounts — film grain, chromatic aberration, bloom.

frame

One engine tick — time is the caller's scene clock in seconds, dpr the device pixel ratio for resolution-scaled passes. The caller's rAF loop is the only clock (frame-budget rule).

ray_at

Screen→world picking ray → [ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz]. Per-pick, never per-frame — JS intersects it against body bounds itself.

destroy

Drops the surface + every GPU resource it owns.

(module scope)

The generated wasm-pack glue module shape for the scene3d crate: the async wasm initializer plus the mount async constructor that returns the engine handle.

default

Async initializer returning the wasm exports.

mount

Engine constructor — binds the canvas to the shared GPUDevice and configures the surface. Sync under the hood (no promises left in wasm init); await tolerates the plain return unchanged.

(module scope)

Live scene handle returned by mountScene3d.

canvas

The canvas the engine draws into (the caller's element).

surface

The wasm Surface3d — call its flat id-API directly.

destroy

Disconnects the ResizeObserver + drops the surface.

(module scope)

Default module loader — dynamic-imports the wasm-pack glue at the registry URL. @vite-ignore keeps vite from resolving the build-optional artifact; a 404 rejects and the caller falls back. Injectable for tests.

  • @param url Artifact glue URL.

resizeScene3d

Pushes the canvas's current device-px size into the engine — the same DPR-aware measurement the widget bridge performs, shared by the mount path and the ResizeObserver arm.

  • @param surface The live engine handle.
  • @param canvas The host canvas.

(module scope)

Mounts the scene3d engine on canvas: loads the artifact, runs the async mount (adapter + device + configure), wires a ResizeObserver feeding device-px resize, and returns the live handle. Resolves null on ANY capability/artifact/init failure — the caller keeps its existing renderer, so mounting can never regress the page.

  • @param canvas The scene's dedicated canvas element.
  • @param loadModule Injectable module loader (tests substitute a stub).

(module scope)

Decodes url through the shared wasm image pipeline (fetch → worker createImageBitmap → GPU texture, zero CPU readback) and uploads it — the texture half of THREE.TextureLoader.loadAsync. Resolves the registry texture id, or null when decode/upload fails so the caller falls back to a procedural color (same contract as the engines' missing-texture arm).

  • @param surface The live engine handle.
  • @param url CDN image URL.
  • @param targetW GPU resize-hint width.
  • @param targetH GPU resize-hint height.
